title: Fifty-femtosecond trajectory walkthrough
description: Validate and inspect a centered 101-frame molecular-dynamics trajectory slice with backend-managed exports.

guide.action: Zip the data/md/frames directory if using the unpacked source tree, or upload the frames from this bundle as a ZIP.
Set the timestep to 0.5 fs and confirm 101 frames over 0.05 ps.
Download the generated metrics CSV plus first and last structure exports.
